title: m.room.hydration
description: State event in a data room referencing a khora.hydration.v1 bundle (SPEC §21.5). Lets new devices, offline peers, and re-joining members fast-bootstrap a room without walking /sync from genesis.

state_key.description: Bundle version label (e.g. 'v1.0.0'). Multiple m.room.hydration events with different state_keys may coexist; bootstrap selects the most recent one whose schema versions it accepts.

format.description: Bundle format identifier. Future versions mint a new identifier.

primary_uri.description: Authenticated-media URI of the bundle. SPEC §3.3 / §21.5.

fallback_url.description: Optional HTTPS / IPFS / Arweave fallback for when the primary mxc cannot be fetched.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bundle bytes (base64 or hex).

as_of_event.description: Matrix event ID at which the bundle's state was captured. Importing devices /sync incrementally past this event.

produced_by.description: Matrix user ID of the producing party.

produced_by_device.description: Optional Matrix device ID of the producing device, for signature verification.

schema_versions.description: Map of schema_id → schema_version covered by the bundle. Importers refuse incompatible bundles.

signature.description: Optional Ed25519 signature over the bundle bytes by the producing device.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry; bootstrap may decline to use bundles past this point. Null = no expiry.
